steps.en: Plug a mono mic into a 64-bit Linux box, run the installer and answer its prompts
steps.zh: 64 位 Linux 机器接上单声道麦克风，跑安装脚本并回答提问

steps.en: Installs Docker if missing, pulls the image and registers a boot-time systemd service
steps.zh: 缺 Docker 就装上，拉取镜像，注册开机自启的 systemd 服务

steps.en: Open the web UI the installer prints and confirm your latitude/longitude
steps.zh: 打开安装脚本给出的网页地址，确认经纬度

steps.en: Cuts the live audio into 3-second windows and scores each one with BirdNET v2.4
steps.zh: 把实时音频切成 3 秒一段，逐段用 BirdNET v2.4 打分

steps.en: Drops species implausible at your location and waits for repeat hits before confirming
steps.zh: 剔除本地不该出现的物种，重复命中后才确认

steps.en: Saves the detection and its audio clip, updates the dashboard and fires your alert rules
steps.zh: 保存检出记录和音频片段，刷新仪表盘并触发告警规则

value.en: A dated, playable log of which species called near your mic, without anyone holding a phone up
value.zh: 得到一份带时间、可回放的鸟种记录，不用有人举着手机守着

sources: https://github.com/tphakala/birdnet-go/wiki/installation (what install.sh does: Docker, nightly image, prompts, systemd service; http://<your-ip-address>:<port>)
https://github.com/tphakala/birdnet-go/wiki/detection-pipeline (3s window at 48kHz for BirdNET v2.4, filtering, DB / clip / SSE / alert dispatch)
https://github.com/tphakala/birdnet-go/wiki/FAQ (set location for the range filter; false-positive filter needs repeated detections)
